seoTitle: Frequently Asked Questions | Rentwin Car Rental
seoDescription: Everything you need to know about renting with Rentwin: minimum age, required documents, deposit, mileage limit, fuel policy, toll charges and more.
intro: We've gathered the answers to the questions we hear most about renting a car. If you can't find what you're looking for, reach us from the Contact page.

items.q: What is the minimum age to rent a car?
items.a: You must be at least 25 years old and have held a driving licence for at least 3 years.

items.q: Which documents do I need to rent?
items.a: A valid driving licence, a national ID card (passport for non-Turkish citizens) and a credit card in the renter's name.
No. Rentwin does not require a deposit when you rent a car.
Daily rentals have a 300 km mileage limit. For longer trips you can request the unlimited-mileage option when booking. Every kilometre over the limit is charged at 6 TL.
Return the car with the fuel at the same level it was handed over. Any shortfall is billed at the unit price stated in the rental agreement.

items.q: How are bridge and motorway (HGS / OGS) tolls charged?
items.a: Tolls incurred during the rental are queried through the system after the car is returned, and the amount found is invoiced to you.

items.q: Can I drop the car off in another city?
items.a: Yes, one-way rentals are possible. A one-way fee is added to the agreement for this; contact us for the details.

items.q: Do you deliver to the airport?
items.a: Yes. We deliver cars to İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport with a meet-and-greet service — just note the request when booking. Contact us for delivery to an address you specify as well.

items.q: Can I add an extra driver to the agreement?
items.a: Yes. Every driver who will use the car must be listed on the agreement and must each meet the minimum age and licence requirements.

items.q: How do I cancel or change my reservation?
items.a: You can cancel your reservation, or request a date / vehicle change, by phone, e-mail or WhatsApp. Cancellations made more than 24 hours before pick-up are free of charge.

items.q: What should I do in an accident or breakdown?
items.a: Make sure you are safe first, file an accident report if there is a collision, and call our 24/7 roadside assistance line. Our team will help you through the process.

items.q: Can I take the car outside Turkey?
items.a: No. Rentwin vehicles may not be taken outside Turkey's borders.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Cash, credit card and bank transfer.
